Beta client 1.60.1.69893 (400647, 400669, 400670): 15% at both ranks, one charge per rank, 15 sec. Shatter's crit bonus is folded into this aura because a raid boss can never be chilled or frozen by anything else.
44543.tooltip:
Your Chill effects have a 15% chance to grant Fingers of Frost, which treats your next spell cast, or next 2 at rank 2, as though the target were frozen. Lasts 15 sec.
While it is up your spells gain Shatter's critical strike chance, 17/33/50%, and Ice Lance deals its frozen damage.
